question: Among all vampire superheroes who possess the 'Flight' power, find the one with the highest Speed attribute value and return their full name.

prediction.sql:
SELECT s.XCL_020
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.XCL_025 = r.XCL_016
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.XCL_013 = sp.XCL_030
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
WHERE r.XCL_017 = 'Vampire'
  AND sp.XCL_031 = 'Flight'
  AND a.XCL_004 = 'Speed'
ORDER BY ha.XCL_011 DESC
LIMIT 1
